descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S04 Where the status is set (add form, chart header) x state x context: the choice is saved and survives a reload (Tim's specs)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 The manual add form has the three-state toggle (New Admission / Follow-up / Consult) at creation, it defaults to Follow-up, and the state chosen there (or left untouched) is the one saved (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2; TFA-92584 AC 3)
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U11 The app never sets the status from dictation, in either direction (up to New Admission / Consult, or down to Follow-up): add-form dictation, pre-round Save Note, encounter Save & Extract, Quick Dicta … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 5)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Add Patient (/rounding/add) and Add Resident (/snf/add) forms; Hospital patients created by the specs (one with no status, one seeded New Admission); a Nursing Home resident created by the spec

When Add form classes: untouched (Nursing Home) / Consult chosen (Hospital) / New Admission chosen (Nursing Home), submitted. Chart header: New Admission, Consult, Follow-up chosen in turn (Hospital and Nursing Home), reloading after each

Then Both add forms start at Follow-up; the row is saved with the state chosen and today's day; an untouched Nursing Home add stores Follow-up; after every header change and reload the select value and the badge agree and the stored encType matches; dictated notes never change it

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions (toHaveValue on 'Encounter Type' and 'Admission status', badge text, rounding:list / snf:list encType / encTypeDay). Not in these specs: an untouched Hospital add submitted and Consult chosen on the Nursing Home form (S26). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).
